EVENT PITCH EMAIL TEMPLATE
==========================

Copy this and replace every [bracketed] part. Send to libraries,
bookstores, or community centers 6-8 weeks before your desired date.

Subject: Event proposal: [Book title] talk at [venue]

Hi [Venue contact name],

I'm [Author name], a [role/credential] based in [city/state] and author
of [Book title], a [genre] book about [topic]. [One sentence of
background.]

I'd like to propose a [30–60 minute] talk/reading at [venue] for
[audience], ideally [month/season]. I can bring copies of my book to
sign or sell, and I'll handle my own promotion.

Here is a rough outline:
- Welcome and introductions (5 min)
- Who I am and why I wrote the book (10 min)
- Reading or short demo (15 min)
- Q&A (10 min)
- Where to find the book and newsletter sign-up (5 min)

Are you scheduling events for [season]? I'd be happy to answer any
questions.

Thanks,
[Author name]
[Author email]
[Website]
